scope: offline architecture-function profiles plus CPU implementation validation, then numerical GEMM/attention gates
RSQ: full2^23 mantissas at exponent127 and128; direct inline PTX rsqrt; raw FP32 outputs, verify independently against prior saved source factors
EX2: optional after RSQ pass, full2^32 FP32 input bits; raw outputs; at most16GiB; no workload-selected inputs
gates: bitwise exact, preserve failures; no row-index repair or source Golden runtime injection
upstream_use: research method inspiration; own runtime forbids auto GPU probing/FP64 and generic unsupported GEMM recipes
not_promoted: profiles do not certify their target timing
